sections.name: Kia Sorento
lines: The Kia Sorento is Kia's big seven seat SUV, sold in markets like the US, Europe and Australia.
The fourth generation arrived in 2020, on an all new platform.
Depending on the market, you can get petrol, diesel, a hybrid, or a plug in hybrid.
The plug in hybrid can drive around fifty kilometres on electricity alone, before the engine starts.
Three rows of seats, and all wheel drive on many versions.
Big screens, and a clever camera that shows your blind spot in the dials when you indicate.
It is not sold in India, where Kia's three row SUV is the Carens and the electric E V nine.
A roomy, efficient family hauler, with a hybrid for every need.
